data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: Strategy F cluster dispatch loop in runner.py ignores oversized_single_file=True flag from region_split.py — oversized file diffs (LOC > loc_threshold) are dispatched to LLM without truncation, causing token budget exhaustion and non-JSON responses from claude-opus-4-7. Fix: emit skip/OVER_BOUND cluster result for oversized_single_file=True specs rather than dispatching to LLM.
